title: Identification and validation of coagulation and fibrinolytic-related diagnostic biomarkers for ulcerative colitis by bioinformatics analysis.
authors: Li, Feng-Yun; Wu, Xue; Yao, Mei-Fang; Zhang, Juan; Mo, Yuan-Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学分析鉴定溃疡性结肠炎凝血纤溶相关诊断标志物，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Abnormalities in coagulation and fibrinolytic status have been demonstrated to be relevant to inflammatory bowel disease. Nevertheless, there is no study to methodically examine the role of the coagulation and fibrinolysis-related genes in the diagnosis of ulcerative colitis (UC). UC-related datasets (GSE169568 and GSE94648) were originated from the Gene Expression Omnibus database. The biomarkers related to coagulation and fibrinolysis were identified through combining differentially expressed analysis and machine learning algorithms. Moreover, Gene Set Enrichment Analysis and immune analysis were carried out. A total of 4 biomarkers (MAP2K1, CREBBP, TAF1, and HP) were identified, and biomarkers were markedly enriched in pathways related to immunity, such as T-cell receptor signaling pathway, primary immunodeficiency, chemokine signaling pathway, etc. In total, the infiltrating abundance of 4 immune cells between UC and control was markedly different, namely eosinophils, macrophage M0, resting mast cells, and regulatory T cells. And all biomarkers were significantly relevant to eosinophils. Our findings detected 4 coagulation and fibrinolysis-related biomarkers (MAP2K1, CREBBP, TAF1, and HP) for UC, which contributed to the advancement of UC for further clinical investigation.
abstract_zh: 凝血和纤溶状态的异常已被证明与炎症性肠病相关。然而，目前尚无研究系统性地探讨凝血和纤溶相关基因在溃疡性结肠炎（UC）诊断中的作用。UC相关数据集（GSE169568和GSE94648）来源于基因表达综合数据库。通过结合差异表达分析和机器学习算法，鉴定了与凝血和纤溶相关的生物标志物。此外，进行了基因集富集分析和免疫分析。共鉴定出4个生物标志物（MAP2K1、CREBBP、TAF1和HP），这些标志物显著富集于与免疫相关的通路中，如T细胞受体信号通路、原发性免疫缺陷、趋化因子信号通路等。总体而言，UC与对照组之间4种免疫细胞的浸润丰度存在显著差异，即嗜酸性粒细胞、巨噬细胞M0、静息肥大细胞和调节性T细胞。所有生物标志物均与嗜酸性粒细胞显著相关。我们的研究结果发现了4个与凝血和纤溶相关的UC生物标志物（MAP2K1、CREBBP、TAF1和HP），这有助于推动UC的进一步临床研究。
